question: The usable plot area is about 10.6 ha after setbacks, which is not enough for the power block, laydown, pre-assembly and contractor facilities. Will the Owner exercise its option on the 5 ha field north of the plot?
response: Accepted: the Owner will exercise the option; the 5 ha field north of the plot is available free of charge from 2027-03-01 until Taking-Over; the Contractor restores it to its original condition.
